rules: Create every product as DRAFT. Do not publish until the owner approves prices and images.

Prices: a variant uses maison_retail_price_aed from pricing-worksheet.csv when filled; otherwise the competitor placeholder is used. Placeholders are NOT Maison prices (822 of 822 SKUs still on placeholders).

Images are AI-generated brand images (see image_status). originalSource holds a local path: upload each file with stagedUploadsCreate and replace it with the returned resourceUrl before calling productSet.
Metafields in namespace 'maison' marked Internal only must not be rendered on the storefront.
Arabic translations are machine-drafted and need native review; register them with translationsRegister (locale 'ar').
Do not add competitor names, URLs or photos to the store.
